description.narrative: The Hue City Fishing Association, under the Vietnam Fishing Association, is implementing the initiative “Green Fisheries – CircularEconomy initiated by Women in Hue City”, funded by Oxfam Novib. The project runs for 18 months in Phong Quang Ward, Thuan An Ward, Phu Vinh Commune, and Vinh Loc Commune—coastal and lagoon areas where fishing and seafood processing are key livelihoods. The initiative addresses the dual challenges of gender inequality and environmental degradation in the fisheries sector. Although women contribute significantly to the seafood value chain—from processing and trading to financial management—their roles remain undervalued. Simultaneously, local seafood processing generates considerable plastic waste and lacks access to green technologies and finance. The overall goal is to promote green growth, circular economy, and gender equality in the fisheries sector. The project’s objectives include:Enhancing women’s leadership and organizational capacity in fisheries cooperatives and associations through training, technicalsupport, and peer-learning exchanges. Supporting the adoption of green and circular production models, emphasizing plastic reduction, waste reuse, and sustainable seafood processing. Improving access to finance and markets for women-led production units and cooperatives to develop “green OCOP” products and reach environmentally conscious consumers. Main activities include baseline surveys, specialized training, study tours to Hoi An and Da Nang, technical consulting, exhibitions, and financial pitching sessions. The initiative will also produce a “Women-led Green Fisheries Practice Guide” and document success stories through photo-voice and videos. Direct beneficiaries are at least 30 production and business organizations—including cooperatives and fisheries associations—with over70% women participation, and around 60 managers and workers trained in green growth and financial access. By integrating women’s empowerment with circular economy practices, the initiative contributes to the National Green Growth Strategy (2021–2030) and SDGs 5, 12, 13, and 14, fostering an inclusive, climate-resilient, and sustainable fisheries sector in Hue City.

participating-org.narrative: The Hue City Fishing Association is a professional social organization that works with diverse groups of fishers, including both men and women, to promote sustainable and inclusive fisheries development. While its primary mandate focuses on community-based resource management, livelihood improvement, and capacity building, the association places strong emphasis on gender equality and women’s participation as integral elements of its approach. The Hue City Fishing Association was established since 2003 in Hue city. The Association constantly strengthens grassroots branches, helping branches and members operate in the right direction and effectively, contributing to local economic development.
